# A Count for the Slate

*Brindle keeps a weekly slate of sightings by the gate, and Stonefang Pass has gone uncounted since the carters stopped reporting. Hunt 20 seep toads and 20 dark stumps along the pass and bring Brindle a count.*

## Objectives

- Defeat 20 [Seep Toad](../monsters/seep_toad.md)
